name: Blueberry Cove Sailing Camps
operator_name: University of Maine Cooperative Extension 4-H (4-H Camp & Learning Centers at Tanglewood & Blueberry Cove)
description_short: Two-week sailing sessions at Blueberry Cove, taught by the St. George Community Sailing Foundation, combined with regular camp activities. There is an overnight option for ages 10-14 and a Monday-Friday day option for ages 9-12.
swim_waterfront_notes: Sailing instruction by the St. George Community Sailing Foundation; many instructors are certified by US Sailing. The curriculum covers safety and capsize and overboard recovery. Swim requirements are not stated.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Sailing Camps, 9-14 - 4-H Camp & Learning Centers at Tanglewood & Blueberry Cove - University of Maine Cooperative Extension

warnings: The page covers both overnight and day sailing programs, so camp_type is set to 'specialty' (sailing focus). Overnight Sailors is sleepaway and Day Sailors is day camp.

Overnight sessions run Sunday-Thursday (the overnight program ends Thursday). Sailing on Friday is optional and campers have to get there on their own. Campers in the Weeks 2-3 and 6-7 sessions stay over the weekend.
price_per_week left blank: prices are for two-week sessions ($900 day, $1950 overnight).
The contact phone and Orono location in the footer belong to UMaine Extension, not the camp site.
